Hosted on the Austrian Parliament document site, not the Commission site. EURES, social security and EHIC passages left out. items.stated_text: In the field of access to the labour market, Croatia has completed alignment with the acquis.
items.summary: Croatia has completed alignment with the acquis on access to the labour market.

items.extraction_note: Allowed by logged exception LIM-0027 (comparator documents from 2007 onwards on RI-FMW-001 for Croatia).

pass2.classification_note: implementation: Sub-area rating on access to the labour market. Completed legal alignment before accession, not evidence of effect.

items.stated_text: A transitional arrangement has been agreed whereby for the first two years following accession, current Member States will apply nati onal measures, or bilateral agreements, to regulate the access of Croatian workers to their labour markets. These arrangements may continue for up to a maximum of seven years.
items.summary: For two years after accession, Member States may regulate Croatian workers’ access by national measures or bilateral agreements, up to seven years.
